subject: gk
question: Which article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the right to manage religious affairs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 26**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
**Article 26:**

 
 
• Article 26 of the Indian Constitution guarantees the right to manage religious affairs.
 
• It gives every religious denomination or any section thereof the right to establish and maintain institutions for religious and charitable purposes. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• It also allows them to manage their own affairs in matters of religion.
 
• It provides the right to own and acquire movable and immovable property.
 
• It also allows them to administer such property in accordance with law.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Article 25:**

 
 
• Article 25 of the Indian Constitution guarantees the freedom of conscience and free profession, practice, and propagation of religion. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• It ensures that all persons are equally entitled to freedom of conscience and the right freely to profess, practice, and propagate religion. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• It is subject to public order, morality, and health.
 
• It includes the right to wear and carry articles of faith.
 
• It does not directly address the management of religious affairs by religious denominations.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Article 28:**

 
 
• Article 28 of the Indian Constitution deals with freedom as to attendance at religious instruction or religious worship in certain educational institutions. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• It states that no religious instruction shall be provided in any educational institution wholly maintained out of State funds. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• It allows religious instruction in educational institutions administered by the State but established under any trust or endowment requiring such instruction.
 
• It does not give the right to manage religious affairs.
 
• It is focused on religious instruction within educational institutions.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Article 27:**

 
 
• Article 27 of the Indian Constitution deals with freedom as to payment of taxes for promotion of any particular religion.
 
• It states that no person shall be compelled to pay any taxes, the proceeds of which are specifically appropriated in payment of expenses for the promotion or maintenance of any particular religion or religious denomination. 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
• It is focused on preventing the state from compelling citizens to support any particular religion through taxation.
 
• It does not provide the right to manage religious affairs.
 
• It is about the freedom from taxation for religious purposes.
